title: Pope Leo XIV arrives in Peru for final leg of South American journey
detail: Pope Leo XIV landed at Callao Air Base on 11 November, greeted by President Keiko Fujimori and Foreign Minister Carlos Espá, opening a Peru visit after Uruguay and Argentina. Itinerary includes Lima, Chiclayo (where he was bishop 2015–2023), Cusco and Pucallpa, closing with Mass at Las Palmas Air Base on 16 November before returning to Rome. The government declared the visit of national interest.
